data.name: Hezekiel
data.long_meaning: God will strengthen whom He may choose. Derived from the Hebrew words 'hazek' (strength) and 'el' (God).
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes faith and trust in God's strength and guidance.
data.numerology_meaning: Nurturing and loving, with a strong desire to help others.

in_hebrew.name: יחזקאל
in_hebrew.meaning: אלוהים יחזק אתי - אלוהים מחזק אותי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יחזקאל מורכב מיחזק - לחזק, ואל - האלוהים. הוא מופיע בתנ"ך בספר יחזקאל, הנביא שקיבל את השם הזה כי אלוהים חיזק אותו לנבא ולהשמיע את דבריו לעם ישראל. הנביא יחזקאל חי במאה ה-6 לפני הספירה, בתקופת הגלות בבבל, והוא ידוע בנבואותיו על חורבן ירושלים והמקדש, וגם על השבתאיות והשגחת האל על עמו.

in_greek.name: Ἠζεκιήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Ἠζεκιήλ προέρχεται από την Εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει 'ο Θεός θα ενδυνατώσει'. Στο Χριστιανισμό, το όνομα αυτό συνδέεται με τον προφήτη Ιεζεκιήλ, που αναφέρεται στην Παλαιά Διαθήκη. Ο προφήτης Ιεζεκιήλ έζησε τον 6ο αιώνα π.Χ. και έλαβε το όνομα αυτό επειδή ο Θεός τον ενδυνάμωσε να μιλήσει και να προφητεύσει στον λαό του Ισραήλ.

in_latin.name: Hezekiel
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Hezekiel significat 'Deus confortabit' vel 'Deus fortis est'. In traditione Christiana, hoc nomen refertur ad prophetam Ezechielem, qui in Vetere Testamento commemoratur. Propheta Ezechiel saeculo VI a.C. vixit et nomen hoc accepit quia Deus eum confortavit ad loquendum et prophetandum populo Israel.

in_english.name: Hezekiel
in_english.meaning: God will strengthen or God strengthens
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hezekiel originates from the Hebrew name יחזקאל (Yechezkel), meaning 'God will strengthen' or 'God strengthens'. In Christianity, Hezekiel is a significant prophetic name found in the Old Testament. The prophet Ezekiel lived in the 6th century BC and received this name because God strengthened him to prophesy and speak to the Israelites. The name Hezekiel symbolizes divine support and empowerment, reflecting the prophet's role as a messenger of God's word.

biblical_reference.note: The prophet Ezekiel's book is a major part of the Hebrew Bible and the Christian Old Testament.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hezekiah holds significant cultural value in the Old Testament of the Bible. Hezekiah was a king of Judah, renowned for his piety and strong resolve to lead his people in religious and spiritual revival during a particularly dark time in Jewish history. His reign marked the beginning of a period called the Babylonian Captivity, and his actions, such as repairing the temple and restoring Passover, left a lasting impact on Jewish cultural identity.
data.spiritual_significance: Hezekiah's name is a reminder of the power of God's strength in the face of adversity and spiritual darkness. In the Bible, Hezekiah demonstrated a strong faith and trust in God, even despite the challenges and dangers he faced. As such, the name Hezekiah is an inspiring symbol of God's enduring power to strengthen those who turn to Him. It also serves as a reminder that we can draw strength from our faith in God in all aspects of our lives.

historical_references.reference: Hezekiah was a king of Judah in the late 8th century BCE. He ruled during a time of political and military instability, and was able to restore Temple worship and repel an Assyrian invasion.
historical_references.context: Political and military instability during his reign; restoration of Temple worship; repelled Assyrian invasion

historical_references.reference: Hezekiah is mentioned in the Hebrew Bible, specifically in the Books of Kings and Isaiah. He is described as a faithful king who followed the commands of God and led the people of Judah in obedience to Him.
historical_references.context: Mentioned in the Hebrew Bible as a faithful king who followed God's commands and led the people of Judah in obedience

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Hezekiel, which means 'God will strengthen' in Hebrew, has seen a resurgence in popularity in modern times. It is often associated with its biblical origins and the strength and leadership qualities implied by its meaning. Hezekiah was a king of Judah in the Bible, known for his faith in God and his military successes. This name can be found on various social media platforms, as well as baby naming websites where parents select unique and meaningful names for their children. In literary works, Hezekiel is a character in several novels and poems, where the name is used to convey themes of strength, perseverance, and faith.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named David Hezekiel in Dublin, Ireland credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Hezekiel, which means "God will strengthen". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.

data.spiritual_symbolism: Hezekiah: God will strengthen or God's strength shall be exalted. This name symbolizes trust in God's power and strength during times of hardship and difficulty. It is a reminder to lean on God's strength and not our own.
